messages.subject: leaflet and leafletProxy error
parts:
Hi all
I am developing an app where the user can select a species and the point records show up on a map.
However everytime they select a new species, the map re-zooms and goes back to the original layer. I tried to put the data part inside a leafletProxy wrapped in an observe command, but I get an error that says:
"Warning: Unhandled error in observer: wrong arguments for subsetting an environment"

Here is my server code below.
Thanks
Andrew 

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  filteredPresData<-reactive({
    spp<-input$spp.select
    yr<-as.numeric(input$yr.select)
    obs<-input$obs.select
    
    #Select the data of the species you are plotting...
    pres.data<-ebird.data[ebird.data[[spp]]>0 & ebird.data$Year==yr & ebird.data[['Observer']]%in%obs,c(4,3)]
    colnames(pres.data)<-c("lng","lat")
    return(list(pres.data=pres.data))
  })#End of function....
  #~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  output$mymap<-renderLeaflet({
    m<-leaflet() %>%
      setView(lng = 175.5, lat = -41.2, zoom = 9) %>%
      addProviderTiles("MapQuestOpen.OSM", group = "MapQuest") %>%
      addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldTopoMap", group = "Topo") %>%
      addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldStreetMap", group = "Street") %>%
      addLayersControl(
        baseGroups = c("MapQuest","Topo","Street"),
        options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
      )
    m
  })
  
  observe({
    pres.data<-filteredPresData()$pres.data
    leafletProxy("mymap") %>% addCircleMarkers(lng=pres.data$lng,lat=pres.data$lat)#, radius=6, color="red", fillOpacity=0.8, stroke=FALSE)
  })
  
  
  
  output$show_pts<-renderUI({
    checkboxInput("show.pts", label="Show actual locations",value=1)
  })
  output$show_occ<-renderUI({
    checkboxInput("show.occ", label="Show occupancy grid",value=1)
  })  
  
  
})
